rationale: The Wikimedia pageview measurement has documented first-party counting rules that explicitly define which requests are included and excluded, and automated traffic is classified using user-agent and custom-pattern detection. The measurement therefore has a documented methodology and a bounded meaning for the proposition that Wikimedia counted changes in requests to the Docker article.
stated_limitation: Automated traffic detection is heuristic, and the retrieved Wikimedia documentation does not establish a complete revision/backfill policy for historical pageview values. Historical measurements may therefore be affected by classification changes or later revisions.

basis.summarized_finding: The pageview definition is an explicit conjunction of HTTP-status, host and header conditions with an enumerated exclusion list; automated traffic is tagged by ua-parser plus custom regex.
